WITH jun AS (
  SELECT l.sku_scanned AS sku, sum(l.qty) units, sum(l.line_amount) rev,
         sum(l.qty*p.cost_inr) cogs
  FROM store.pos_lines l JOIN store.products p ON p.sku=l.sku_scanned
  WHERE l.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND l.bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1),
wo AS (SELECT sku, sum(units) wo_units FROM store.write_offs WHERE date>='2026-06-01' AND date<'2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1),
emp AS (SELECT sku, count(*) empty_audits FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE status='empty' AND audit_ts>='2026-06-01' AND audit_ts<'2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1),
fc AS (SELECT sku, sum(forecast_units_per_day) fc_units, count(*) fc_days FROM store.forecasts WHERE date>='2026-06-01' AND date<'2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1),
sc AS (SELECT sku, sum(abs(adjustment)) abs_adj, sum(adjustment) net_adj FROM store.stock_counts WHERE count_ts>='2026-06-01' AND count_ts<'2026-07-01' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT p.sku, p.name, p.flow, p.price_inr, p.cost_inr,
  round(p.price_inr-p.cost_inr,2) unit_margin, round((p.price_inr-p.cost_inr)/p.price_inr*100,1) margin_pct,
  j.units jun_units, j.rev jun_rev, round(j.rev-j.cogs,2) jun_gross_profit,
  coalesce(w.wo_units,0) wo_units, coalesce(e.empty_audits,0) empty_audits,
  round(fc.fc_units,1) fc_units, coalesce(sc.abs_adj,0) count_abs_adj
FROM store.products p
LEFT JOIN jun j ON j.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN wo w ON w.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN emp e ON e.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN fc f ON f.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN sc s ON s.sku=p.sku
LEFT JOIN fc ON fc.sku=p.sku
ORDER BY jun_gross_profit DESC NULLS LAST;

## Final answers

**Q1 — Range decisions (add/drop).** The records hold June margin, shrink and stockout facts for all 11 ranged SKUs, but there is **no candidate-product list and no demand data for anything outside the range**, so "add" cannot be answered from records. On "drop", the signal is clear: the two DSD milk lines carry the worst margin (5.0% each) and essentially all the shrink (494 of 504 write-off units in June). **MILK-FC-500ML** is the drop candidate (₹1.70/unit margin, 198 units expired/damaged write-offs in June = 6.8% of its June units, only ₹4,957 gross profit); **MILK-TONED-500ML** is a review case (same 5.0% margin, 296 write-off units, but ₹224,874 revenue / ₹11,244 gross profit — it is the traffic driver). Unmet demand exists only in products already ranged (ATTA-WW-5KG empty twice, SUGAR-1KG once), which is a stock-up, not a range-add.

**Q2 — Supplier payment terms and working capital.** There is **no supplier entity, no invoice table and no terms/due-date/payable column anywhere** in `store`, `warehouse` or `payments`; `store_orders.reason` is only `'auto'`. So payment terms = no record. Working capital is likewise only partly computable: the only measurable component is inventory at cost, **₹62,066.5** at 2026-06-28; there are no payables, no cash-on-hand and no receivables records (UPI is settled daily through 2026-06-30, so receivables ≈ 0). Full working capital cannot be computed.

**Q3 — Payment complaints in June 2026: 26** (23 "charged twice", 3 "debited but the till said failed"). All 26 complaint rows fall in June.

**Q4 — Profitability in June 2026.** Revenue ₹1,243,937 (till lines, cross-checked against `daily_sales` unit×price) less COGS at product cost ₹1,107,731.1 = **gross profit ₹136,205.9 (10.95%)**; write-offs at cost ₹15,269.1 bring it to ~₹120,937. So the store is profitable at gross level, but **no overhead records exist (no rent, labour, utilities), so net/overall profitability is not determinable**.

**Q5 — Shelf-audit rows showing empty in June 2026: 3** (SUGAR-1KG on 06-05; ATTA-WW-5KG on 06-12 and 06-26). All 88 audit rows fall inside June.

**Q6 — Products sold: 11.** `store.products` holds 11 SKUs, `pos_lines` shows 11 distinct `sku_scanned`, and no SKU appears anywhere outside the product master.

**Q7 — Cashier productivity: no record.** No cashier/till-operator/employee column exists in any table, and `pos_payments.note` is NULL for all 30,949 rows, so payments cannot be attributed to a person.

**Q8 — Price elasticity for 5 kg atta: no record.** `ATTA-WW-5KG` sold at a constant ₹265 on every one of its 1,177 till lines from 2026-05-04 to 2026-06-28 (all 11 SKUs have exactly one distinct `unit_price`), so there is no price variation to estimate elasticity from.
